text: Netcompany says its shareholders holding more than 5% of the shares or voting rights are AC NC Holding ApS — the joint holding company of founders André Rogaczewski and Claus Jørgensen — plus Arbejdsmarkedets Tillægspension and Danske Bank A/S, and that holdings below 5% are anonymous under Danish law.
